entities.summary: Martin Heidenhain was a German anatomist born in Breslau. His father was physiologist Rudolf Heidenhain (1834–1937), and his mother, Fanny Volkmann, was the daughter of anatomist Alfred Wilhelm Volkmann (1800–1877).
